text.text: One of the top 5 ice cream shops in Hanover! I've never had bad ice cream there; the flavors are very interesting and quite creative. The milkshakes are also super delicious. Highly recommended, even a must for ice cream lovers! Enjoy it 😋

originalText.text: Gehört zu den Top 5 Eisladen in Hannover! Ich habe dort noch nie schlechtes Eis gegessen, die Sorten sind sehr interessant und ziemlich kreativ. Auch dir Milchshakes sind Mega lecker. Empfehlenswert sowieso, vielmehr ein Muss für Eisliebhaber! Lasst es euch schmecken 😋

text.text:
Very delicious ice cream, DARK chocolate highly recommended.

2 Euros per scoop for such quality is fine

originalText.text:
Sehr leckeres Eis, DARK chocolate sehr zu empfehlen.

2 Euro pro Kugel für so eine Qualität ist in Ordnung

text.text:
Was there with my kids.

2x spaghetti ice cream and 1x scoop raspberry and 1x scoop orange quark please. Sure, that's 15.60 EUR😵.

Wow!🥳 So that's what "handmade" ice cream that doesn't come from a packet tastes like. Never again ice cream from the standard Italian place around the corner. The money was really worth it! I'd rather eat ice cream less often but really, really good!

About the place.

Everything is very clean and minimalist. No toilets🤔. Cozy is different. But that wasn't my goal. We wanted an ice cream to go and off into the sun. There were small benches outside the door. Completely sufficient!

Service.

Fast, friendly, professional. Top. Contactless payment possible.

Ice cream.

Super delicious! Also some crazier flavors. There's a daily menu with about 12 flavors. I find that very relaxing. Makes the choice easier and speaks for quality. An ice cream parlor that offers 30+X flavors can't make them with fresh ingredients.

Conclusion. Definitely go there. The scoops are big and I mentioned it... very delicious

originalText.text:
War mit meinen Kindern dort.

2x Spagehettieis und 1x Kugel Himbeer und 1x Kugel Orange Quark bitte. Gern, macht 15,60 EUR😵.

Wow!🥳  So scheckt also "handgemachtes" Eis das nicht aus der Tüte kommt. Nie wieder Eis beim Standart Italiener um die Ecke. Das Geld hat sich mal richtig gelohnt! Da geh ich lieber einmal weniger Eis essen dafür aber richtig richtig gut!

Zum Ort.

Alles sehr clean und reduziert. Keine Toiletten🤔. Gemütlich ist anders.  Darum ging es mir auch nicht. Wir wollten ein Eis to go und ab in die Sonne. Vor der Tür standen kleine Bänke. Völlig ausreichend!

Service.

Schnell freundlich professionell. Top. Bezahlen Kontaktlos möglich.

Eis.

Saulecker!  Auch etwas verücktere Sorten. Es gibt eine Tageskarte mit ca 12 Sorten. Finde ich sehr entpannend. Fällt die Auswahl leichter und spricht für Qualität. Eine Eisdiele die 30 Sorten + X anbietet kann die nicht mit frischen  Zutaten machen.

Fazit. Unbedingt hingehen. Die Kugeln sind groß und ich hatte es erwähnt ... sehr  lecker

text.text: Very delicious ice cream, handmade, natural ingredients. I'll try the "Cold Stone" ice cream next. The interior design is... surprising: a cuboid landscape you can sit on. Reminds me a bit of an adventure corner in a daycare. No problem in good weather: ice cream in hand and sat on the ornamental square next door. You can also watch the ice cream production through a window.

originalText.text: Sehr leckeres Eis, handgemacht, natürliche Zutaten. Das Eis vom "Cold Stone" probiere ich als nächstes. Die Inneneinrichtung ist... überraschend: eine Quaderlandschaft, auf die man sich setzen kann. Erinnert mich ein bisschen an eine Abenteuer-Ecke in einer KiTa. Bei gutem Wetter kein Thema: Eis in die Hand und auf den Schmuckplatz nebenan gesetzt. Dafür kann man durch eine Scheibe bei der Eisproduktion zusehen.

Currently, the shop is still a bit empty and doesn't invite me to linger on site. I still see potential for the premises here. (But maybe something is already planned here :-))

Aktuell ist der Laden noch etwas leer und lädt für mich nicht zum Verweilen vor Ort ein. Hier sehe ich noch Potential der Räumlichkeiten. (Vielleicht ist hier aber auch schon etwas geplant :-))

Reward: 5 out of 5 scoops – no bullshit.

blocks.text: Real ice cream craftsmanship directly at Schmuckplatz in Hanover

parts.value: Hello, we are the passionate ice cream lovers behind Nicezeit. Since 2019, we have been creating honest, handmade premium ice cream here in Hanover-Linden that simply makes you happy. Our mission is simple: we want to offer you the best ice cream in town, without any frills and with 100 percent natural ingredients.

blocks.alt: Passionate ice cream production in the Linden ice cream parlor

blocks.text: Good ice cream doesn't need frills

parts.value: Our secret is the ingredients – and especially the things we deliberately leave out. We don't use artificial flavors, colorings, or ready-made ice cream powders in our cones. We rely on genuine craftsmanship, regional milk, and absolute transparency. Through the window to our ice cream lab, you can watch us at any time and experience live how your favorite flavor is made.

blocks.text: From creamy classics to the Cookie Hug

parts.value: In our display, you'll find handmade premium ice cream in beloved classic flavors and truly creative original creations like our Leibniz Butterkeks ice cream. Vegan ice cream and plant-based alternatives of the highest quality also have a firm place with us. We also mix refreshing milkshakes, serve classic spaghetti ice cream, or a cool iced matcha latte. And because ice cream enjoyment knows no season, we also surprise you with seasonal highlights like our winter flavors in a glass or warm ice cream in a croissant. Are you planning an event? With our ice cream catering, we bring Nicezeit directly to your celebration.

blocks.text: For true connoisseurs and the entire neighborhood

parts.value: Our Linden ice cream parlor is the meeting point for everyone who appreciates real food craftsmanship. Whether families on a Sunday outing, convinced vegans looking for the perfect plant-based melt, or quality-conscious connoisseurs who are happy to wait in line for a really good product. We make ice cream for people who want to taste the difference and value regional ingredients.

blocks.text: Passion you can taste in every scoop

parts.value: Since our founding in 2019, we have put our heart and soul into ice cream production. Our concept: We brainstorm, develop, and try until the result puts a real smile on our faces. The fact that we are among the top 5 in Hanover and receive so many great reviews from you makes us incredibly proud. Our glass manufactory is our daily promise to you: real handwork is still done here.

blocks.text: Your ice cream lab in the heart of the neighborhood

parts.value: You'll find our Linden ice cream manufactory in the lively Linden-Nord, directly at the beautiful Schmuckplatz. We are an integral part of the neighborhood here and prefer to source our ingredients directly from the Hanover area. By the way, you can now enjoy Nicezeit not only in Linden but also in our ice cream parlors in List and Südstadt. We are thrilled to supply the entire city with our natural ice cream enjoyment.

blocks.text: We look forward to your visit

parts.value: We cordially invite you to come by and convince yourself of our quality. Grab your loved ones, take a look into our ice cream lab, and find your new favorite flavor. We can't wait to hand you a scoop of real craftsmanship over the counter!

blocks.text: Welcome to Nicezeit – Your Ice Cream Manufactory

parts.value: Hey, I'm Jan Ziehme, owner and passionate ice cream lover. Since 2019, with Nicezeit, I've dedicated myself to genuine, honest ice cream craftsmanship in Hanover. My mission is simple: I want to put a smile on your face with uncompromisingly good ice cream. Good ice cream doesn't need frills, just the best ingredients and a lot of love for detail.

blocks.alt: Jan Ziehme – Owner and ice cream lover in Hanover Südstadt

blocks.text: True craftsmanship without compromise

parts.value: We don't put anything into our ice cream that doesn't belong there. We stand for a completely natural production, without artificial flavors, colorings, or ready-made pastes. In our glass manufactory, you're up close and can watch us directly through the window to the ice cream lab. This way, you can see exactly how your favorite ice cream is created from pure passion and the best raw materials.

blocks.text: Creative flavors and true classics

parts.value: We love to surprise you again and again. In addition to our handmade premium ice cream in classic and completely wild flavors, we mix creamy milkshakes or refreshing iced matcha latte with mango or strawberry for you. Look forward to special creations like our legendary spaghetti ice cream, ice cream in a croissant, or the popular Leibniz Butterkeks ice cream. And because ice cream is always a good idea, we sweeten the cold season for you with our winter varieties in 500ml jars and an exclusive advent calendar. We're also ready for your celebrations: simply use our event catering or rent our ice cream carts for unforgettable moments.

blocks.text: For all who love real taste

parts.value: Our ice cream parlor in Südstadt is the meeting point for true ice cream lovers, families, and quality-conscious connoisseurs from all over Hanover. If you value natural ingredients and creative taste experiences, you've come to the right place. Vegans will also get their money's worth, as we offer a huge selection of plant-based alternatives and vegan ice cream flavors daily, which are at least as creamy as our classics.

blocks.text: Quality you can taste

parts.value: Since 2019, we have dedicated ourselves to established ice cream craftsmanship and are proudly among the top 5 in Hanover. Our 5-star ratings show us every day that the effort for uncompromising quality is worth it. We use only 100% natural ingredients and consistently rely on regional products, such as fresh milk directly from local farmers. You can taste this transparency and freshness with every single spoon.

blocks.text: Your ice cream laboratory in the heart of Hanover

parts.value: You'll find our modern, unconventional cube landscape right in the heart of Südstadt. As your local eisdiele-suedstadt, we are deeply rooted in the neighborhood and work closely with regional suppliers. Come by, make yourself comfortable, and enjoy the relaxed atmosphere in our urban ice cream laboratory.

blocks.text: We look forward to your visit

parts.value: Do you fancy a scoop of pure indulgence or are you planning an event and looking for the perfect catering? Then simply visit us in Südstadt, call us, or send us an email. We cordially invite you to try our latest creations and discover your new favorite flavor.

blocks.text: Eating ice cream in Hanover: 100% natural and handmade

parts.value: Hey, I'm Jan, owner and absolute ice cream lover. Since 2019, we at Nicezeit have been churning our ice cream according to our own recipe and with pure passion. Our mission is simple: we want to offer you the best handmade ice cream in Hanover, without any frills. In our transparent manufactory at Schmuckplatz in Linden, you can watch us produce it live. We use 100% natural ingredients and regional milk. We brainstorm, try, and develop until the result puts a real smile on our faces. Whether in a cone on site or from our ice cream truck in Hanover – quality always comes first for us.

blocks.alt: Jan Ziehme – owner and ice cream lover in Hanover

blocks.text: Ice Cream Truck Hanover & Manufactory: Pure Taste without Frills

parts.value: We put absolutely nothing into our ice cream that doesn't belong there.

We rely on honest craftsmanship and uncompromising quality for your perfect taste experience. That's why we use only 100% natural ingredients and create our premium ice cream without artificial flavors or colorings. Our base is fresh, regional milk directly from farms in the area. Good ice cream doesn't need tricks, just the best raw materials and a lot of attention to detail.

blocks.text: Creative flavors and your ice cream truck in Hanover

parts.value: Discover our variety from classic favorites to crazy ice cream creations.

In addition to our handmade premium ice cream, we offer wonderfully creamy vegan ice cream varieties based on plants. If you fancy something to drink, we'll gladly mix you fresh milkshakes or a cool Iced Matcha Latte with mango or strawberry. Even in winter, we're there for you with creative specials like ice cream in a croissant, ice cream in a 500ml jar, or our popular advent calendar. And if you have something to celebrate: Our event catering with our own ice cream truck in Hanover will make your party unforgettable.

blocks.text: Ice cream truck Hanover: For all who want to taste real quality

parts.value: Whether you have a sweet tooth, are vegan, or on a family outing – everyone will find their new favorite ice cream with us.

We make ice cream for people who prefer to eat really good ice cream in Hanover once, rather than consuming cheap mass-produced goods. Our varieties are aimed at health-conscious people, young adults, and families who value regional ingredients. Whether you love classic milk ice cream or are looking for the best vegan ice cream in Linden, we have just the right thing for you. Come by and make your everyday life a little sweeter.

blocks.text: Eating ice cream in Hanover: Transparency you can see and taste

parts.value: We are proud to be a truly transparent ice cream manufactory.

Through the large window to our ice cream lab at Schmuckplatz, you can watch us directly at any time. You experience live how we produce our ice cream from regional ingredients and work completely transparently. Our excellent customer reviews, which make us one of the top 5 in Hanover, show that this concept works. Since 2019, we have stood for honest craftsmanship that you can fully trust.

blocks.text: Ice Cream Truck Hanover: Your Neighborhood Ice Cream Parlor in Linden, List, and Südstadt

parts.value: We are deeply rooted in Hanover and love our local locations.

You'll find us directly at Schmuckplatz in Linden-Nord, where you can make yourself comfortable on our extraordinary block landscape. But we also supply you with our ice-cold creations as your ice cream parlor in List and Südstadt. We consciously source our raw materials as regional ingredients from the immediate vicinity to strengthen the region and keep transport routes short. Eating ice cream in Hanover always means a piece of home for us.

blocks.text: Rent an ice cream truck in Hanover & experience the manufactory

parts.value: Come by our transparent production or get our ice cream truck for your next event.

Just come by one of our stores and try our latest, handmade varieties. If you're planning a celebration, feel free to contact us and we'll roll up to your location with our ice cream truck in Hanover. We're really looking forward to putting a smile on your and your guests' faces. Let's create your perfect moment of enjoyment together!

blocks.text: Vegan Ice Cream Hanover: True Craftsmanship for Your Moment of Indulgence

parts.value: Hey, I'm Jan Ziehme, owner and absolute ice cream lover. Since 2019, I've been pursuing a clear mission with Nicezeit: We want to make the best vegan ice cream in Hanover, without any compromises. Our concept is simple: We brainstorm, develop, and try until the result puts a smile on our faces. With us, you get honest craftsmanship that you can taste with every spoon.

blocks.alt: Jan Ziehme – Owner and ice cream lover in Hanover

blocks.text: Pure taste without frills – Vegan ice cream from Hanover

parts.value: Absolutely nothing goes into our ice cream that doesn't belong there.

We firmly believe that really good ice cream doesn't need artificial flavors, colorings, or ready-made powder mixes. That's why we rely on 100% natural ingredients and pure passion for our craft. When you enjoy our vegan ice cream in Hanover, you taste the honest quality and attention to detail. We take the time to perfectly tune each flavor so you can enjoy your moment of indulgence completely carefree.

blocks.text: Creative flavors & vegan ice cream in Hanover

parts.value: Discover handmade premium ice cream, refreshing shakes, and crazy winter specials.

Our display case is packed with classic favorites and unusual creations that will surprise you. In addition to creamy milk ice cream, we offer fantastic plant-based vegan ice cream flavors that leave nothing to be desired in terms of taste. We're also happy to mix you creamy milkshakes or an ice-cold Iced Matcha Latte with mango or strawberry. And because we love ice cream all year round, we sweeten the cold season with our seasonal winter specials like ice cream in a croissant, ice cream in a 500ml jar, or our popular advent calendar – and for your next party, you can even hire us for event catering.

blocks.text: Vegan Ice Cream in Hanover: For Everyone Who Loves True Quality

parts.value: Whether vegan, classic or experimental – everyone will find their new favorite flavor with us.

We make ice cream for people who prefer to enjoy something truly good once, rather than spooning cheap mass-produced goods. Families, young adults, and absolute ice cream lovers meet here to have a good time. Especially health-conscious individuals and fans of plant-based cuisine will find our selection of vegan ice cream in Hanover completely satisfying. Make yourself comfortable on our cube landscape and leisurely try our assortment.

blocks.text: Vegan ice cream Hanover: Transparency you can taste

parts.value: Come by and watch us at work in our transparent manufactory.

We have absolutely nothing to hide. Through the large window to our ice cream lab, you can watch live as we create your favorite ice cream from regional milk, plant-based alternatives, and 100% natural ingredients. Since 2019, we have stood for honest craftsmanship without frills. The fact that, thanks to you, we are among the top 5 ice cream parlors in Hanover shows us: pure taste wins.

blocks.text: Eating ice cream in Hanover: Your local manufactory

parts.value: We are deeply rooted in Hanover and prefer to source our ingredients directly from the region.

You can find us right where life happens: in Linden directly at Schmuckplatz, in List and in Südstadt. This local connection is extremely important to us, which is why we also rely on short distances and regional partners for our raw materials. This way, we support our direct surroundings and at the same time guarantee you absolute freshness for your ice cream. Come by your favorite neighborhood and enjoy a piece of genuine Hanoverian ice cream culture.

blocks.text: Ready for really good vegan ice cream in Hanover?

parts.value: We are really looking forward to showing you our latest creations.

Leave everyday life behind for a moment and treat yourself to a scoop of pure indulgence. Whether you're looking for creamy milk ice cream made from regional milk, a crazy new flavor, or the best spot for vegan ice cream in Hanover – we have just the thing for you. Just come by, watch us work through the window to the ice cream lab, and find out why eating ice cream in Hanover is so special with us. We look forward to seeing you!
